docs.summary: Provides reflection information about a shader type's memory layout and field structure. This struct exposes detailed information about how types are laid out in memory within a compiled shader, including size, alignment, field information, and binding details.
Gets the underlying type reflection object for this type layout.
Gets the kind of the shader type (scalar, vector, matrix, struct, array, etc.).
